purpose: ANAT-OFFICIAL-01: selection of public official acts for the configuration screen. Identification only: no text below was copied from any act. Each entry is consulted on the official host, one by one, by ops/anatomy/fetch-official.ts; a URL is confirmed only after the page is opened.
excluded: Convênio ICMS 52/91 and 100/97 (base of ANAT-03, tribusca-control#116)

acts.reason: Long CONFAZ convênio with many later wordings and change notes: exercises editorial notes, previous wordings (RedaoAnt) and validity notes kept apart from structure.
Ajuste SINIEF family (different from convênio): clause numbering with letters (cláusula quarta-A), revoked clauses and effect dates in notes.
Short convênio that references other acts and deadlines: exercises citations and temporal clauses without NCM tables.

acts.act: One recent Ato COTEPE/ICMS with an attached table
acts.reason: Technical act with table annex: exercises table geometry and code columns in CONFAZ HTML.
Very long consolidated IN (PIS/Cofins) with books, chapters, sections and annexes: exercises deep structure and multiple amendments.

acts.act: One recent Ato Declaratório Executivo COANA
acts.reason: Short executive declaratory act: minimal structure, signature and publication data; checks the engine does not invent parts.

acts.act: Lei Complementar 214/2025 as published in the DOU
acts.reason: Long law in DOU HTML (identifica/ementa/assina) with titles, chapters and articles: exercises DOU layout at scale.

acts.act: One DOU rectification (Onde se lê / Leia-se) of a tax act
acts.reason: Rectification: original and corrected text must stay separate and not be read as new provisions.

acts.act: RICMS-SP (Decreto 45.490/2000), one article with later wordings
acts.reason: São Paulo compiled regulation: plain text style, 'Artigo'/'Parágrafo único', notes of new wording with dates.
SP executive act with considerandos and revocation article: exercises nature (revocation) apart from validity.
